problem.out_of_range: This value is out of the allowed range.
problem.invalid_url: Enter the address of the server, with no path after the name, such as https://nido.example.com.
problem.invalid_address: Enter an email address, such as Nido <nido@example.com>.
problem.credentials_go_together: The username and the password go together.
problem.access_not_shorter_than_session: The access token must last less than the session.
problem.public_url_required_by_mail: Mail needs the public address for its links: set it first.
problem.password_required_for_new_server: Type the password again: it is only reused with the server, port and protection it was saved for.

mail_failure.authentication_failed: The server refused the username or the password.
mail_failure.connection_refused: Nothing answers at this address on this port.
mail_failure.unknown_host: There is no server by this name.
mail_failure.timeout: The server did not answer in time.
mail_failure.tls_failed: The encrypted connection failed: check the security and the port.
mail_failure.not_an_smtp_server: What answers at this address is not a mail server.
mail_failure.failed: The email could not be sent.
